## Change type

- [ ] Source or jurisdiction metadata
- [ ] Data extraction or transformation
- [ ] Indicator/methods change
- [ ] Code or schema
- [ ] Documentation

## Evidence and provenance

List source IDs, exact provenance, and any transformation IDs.

## Quality checklist

- [ ] Original wording is retained separately from translation/harmonisation.
- [ ] No identifiable, sealed, credential, or restricted data are included.
- [ ] Schema and validation checks pass.
- [ ] Tests cover changed logic.
- [ ] Breaking changes include migration notes and methods approval.
- [ ] Gold-layer changes have independent second review.
- [ ] Rights/licence implications have been considered.
- [ ] Changelog is updated when user-visible.
